verdict.line: You lose if you eat free Rupture poke on the wave and let Cho'Gath stack Feast kills; you win if you cash in the pre-6 solo-kill window and scale into Trinity Force.

brief.thesis: Cho'Gath has no dash and wins the lane purely through Q (Rupture) poke at 950 range and W (Feral Scream) silence up close; Jax has no way to avoid Rupture's slow but can shrug its area damage with E (Counter Strike) and then close the gap for free with Q (Leap Strike). The 48% head-to-head over 177 games with Jax holding the solo-kill edge means this is a lane about picking the right window to engage, not about raw stats.

theirWindow.when: Q (Rupture) is up, you're near wave
theirWindow.what: Rupture has a 9s cooldown at range 950 and pops/slows anything near the minions, so don't stand in the wave to trade CS when it's available — you'll eat the slow and the follow-up Vorpal Spikes for free.

yourWindow.when: Right after Cho'Gath lands or whiffs Q
yourWindow.what: The instant Rupture goes on cooldown, use Q (Leap Strike) to close the 950-range gap he can no longer threaten, then trigger E (Counter Strike) to dodge his basic attacks and stun him for the trade.

Feast burst vs your attack-speed ult

start.why: Measured at 55.6% win rate over 45 games — the regen and damage-reduction proc directly offsets getting chipped by Rupture and Vorpal Spikes while you wait out cooldowns to engage.

boots.why: 68.1% pick rate and the highest measured win rate (46% over 139 games); the magic resist blunts Rupture, Feral Scream and Vorpal Spikes, and the tenacity shortens how long Feral Scream's silence locks you out of E.

core.why: The proc damage on your empowered Leap Strike auto is what turns the post-Rupture engage window into a real trade instead of a poke exchange.
Extra burst and healing on the E stun payload lets you win the all-in even if Cho'Gath lands Feral Scream first.
Survives the 175-range true-damage Feast once he's banked a few stacks, so a bad all-in doesn't end in an execute.

situational.when: cho'gath has stacked several feast kills and is sitting on a large max-health pool
he's landing feral scream into feast and you need to survive the follow-up burst to win the fight
you're getting bursted down in the all-in before your attack speed stacks from relentless assault can kick in

runes.keystoneWhy: This page measures 60% win rate over 15.7% pick; Grasp punishes Cho'Gath for poking you with Rupture and Vorpal Spikes by healing and growing your health every time he lands a hit, which matches a lane you win by outlasting his pokes until Trinity Force comes online.

summoners.why: Highest measured win rate of the three pages (49.3%) and the most-picked combo (67.3%); Ignite lets you convert your solo-kill advantage into an actual kill in the pre-6 window before Cho'Gath has Feast to punish an all-in.

playing.title: Engage only after Rupture is spent
playing.detail: Rupture is on a 9s cooldown at 950 range — walking up while it's available just eats the slow. Wait for him to use it on the wave or whiff it, then Leap Strike in.

playing.title: Hold E through Feral Scream, not just autos
playing.detail: E (Counter Strike) dodges basic attacks and reduces area-of-effect damage, so timing it to be active when Feral Scream or Rupture lands reduces the burst, not only his auto-attacks.

playing.title: Respect Feast at level 6+
playing.detail: Feast is a 175-range true-damage nuke on a 60s cooldown. Don't stand point-blank under meaningful HP once he hits 6, especially if he's already banked stacks from earlier kills.

playing.title: Push the pre-6 solo-kill window
playing.detail: The data confirms you hold the solo-kill edge in this matchup before Cho'Gath has Feast online — commit to all-ins in levels 3-5 rather than passively farming.

playing.title: Time the real all-in around Trinity Force
playing.detail: The empowered proc from Trinity Force (core item #1) is what converts an even trade into a kill — hold your biggest commitment for roughly levels 9-11 when it completes.

playing.title: Don't facecheck the wave
playing.detail: Vorpal Spikes punishes you for standing in his attack range while last-hitting, and Rupture's 950 range means he can zone the minions from safety — trade in bursts, not standing exchanges.

playing.title: Bait the silence before committing E
playing.detail: Feral Scream has a 13s cooldown and silences — if he's already thrown it on cooldown, your E stun is uncontested; if it's up, bait it out before you commit your own cooldowns.

brief.patchCaveat: Build, runes, summoners and win rates above are measured from real Jax-vs-Cho'Gath games on the current patch (16.20.1) via OP.GG; the ability readings, timing windows, and trade patterns are my own tactical analysis layered on top of that data.

stats.opponentTip: Be careful of Rupture (Q)! Fight Cho’Gath while being wary of Rupture(Q)!
